confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a July 2026 peak-season window. No live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which is the most volatile. FX: the 0.6955 figure comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, and I did not open that page to confirm it. A third-party page showed 0.6979 for 9 October, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on the exact rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated from mid-sized southern Spanish coastal tourist cities with similar pricing, such as Seville, Valencia and Alicante, adjusted for Malaga's strong summer tourist demand. No single comparable city was verified.
